# Honora Hollis

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 c4 P3](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0003), [v3 c4 P9](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0009)</sub>
- **Role:** College student and teacher  <sub>[v3 c4 P3](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0003), [v3 c6 P0](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Nonie  <sub>[v3 c4 P16](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0016), [v3 c6 P0](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Honora is a tall girl with pale, light hair. She is taller than most of her peers, exceeding many in height by a solid two inches. Her appearance is described as fair and ethereal.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P3](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0003), [v3 c4 P6](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0006), [v3 c4 P10](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0010), [v3 c4 P68](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0068)_

## Personality

Honora possesses a nature full of mischief, jokes, and humor beneath her fair and delicate appearance. She is thoughtful, expressive, and deeply values true friendship and sincerity over superficial closeness. She appreciates the beauty in life and approaches both her studies and personal relationships with earnestness.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P3](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0003), [v3 c4 P15](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0015), [v3 c37 P23](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0023)_

## Goals

- Achieve success at college and cultivate meaningful life experiences  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c37 P23](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0023)</sub>

## History

Honora Hollis studied alongside Nell Harcourt at Regent's Academy, where she formed a close friendship with Nell. She later attended Wexcombe College, pursuing Second Year work and specializing in the classics, eventually earning Honors in her subjects. During her time at college, she lived at Tabby's Place on Linden Avenue together with Nell, Cressida Lindsay, Mabel Colby, and Aunt Euphemia. She actively engaged in college social life and societies, participating in gatherings and walks through Portmaris and Old St. John's Cemetery. After completing her studies at Wexcombe, she eventually moved to Japan.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P3](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0003), [v3 c4 P11](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0011), [v3 c4 P12](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0012), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c16 P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 c21 P16](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0016), [v3 c36 P7](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0007), [v3 c37 P23](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0023)_
